identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a trustworthy, human-centric pharmacy marketplace that blends Swiss medical precision with local community warmth.
principles: Fusion: Swiss Typography + Organic Textures + Digital Efficiency
Content First: Medicine info must be readable and accessible
Negative Space: Generous breathing room for clarity
Contrast: High contrast for accessibility and hierarchy

typography.rules: Headings must use 'Outfit' with tight tracking. Body text uses 'Inter' for maximum legibility. Use large, bold numbers for prices and dosage.

colors.rules: Primary Emerald for trust/pharmacy. Accent Rose for urgent actions (Buy, Alerts). Background is Stone-50 (Bone) for a warm, non-sterile feel. No gradients on text. High contrast is mandatory.

strategies.dashboard: Dense, information-rich but breathable. Use cards with subtle borders.
strategies.marketing: Asymmetric, storytelling-focused. Use 'Tetris' grid for visual interest.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/5 rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-muted text-foreground rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-colors

cards.base: bg-white rounded-xl border border-border/40 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow p-6
cards.interactive: cursor-pointer hover:border-primary/50 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 group

inputs.base: flex h-12 w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

usage_rules: Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Dialog, Datepicker, Select).
Customize Shadcn components to match the 'Warm Medical' aesthetic (rounded-xl, stone colors).
Do NOT use default 'slate' grays; tint them warm.

textures.noise: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.03'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")

pharmacist.alt: Friendly pharmacist in a modern pharmacy setting

family.alt: Happy family running in a park

transitions.page: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}

requirements: Focus rings visible on all interactive elements
ARIA labels for all icon buttons

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Do NOT use gradients on text.
Every interaction needs feedback (hover, click, load).
Ensure mobile responsiveness for all pages.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Modern Apothecary' theme. Use the provided images for the landing page and demo data. Follow the color palette strictly - Emerald Green for trust, Rose for alerts. Use the 'Outfit' font for headings to give it a modern, friendly character. Ensure the Pharmacy Dashboard is dense but readable, while the Consumer side is spacious and guiding.
